$comment: Every path is resolved relative to the repository root unless absolute.
MODEL_ROOT deliberately defaults to a location OUTSIDE the repository and
outside /tmp: model weights are multi-GB, must never enter git, and /tmp is
wiped whenever the container is reset (this happened once already).
Override any value with the matching BF_* environment variable.

comfyui.$comment: ComfyUI is used as a service. Install it yourself; see README.

acestep.$comment: ACE-Step is a large text-to-music model. Strongly GPU-preferred.

kokoro.$comment: Kokoro is the primary TTS. Voice pack must be downloaded separately.

piper.$comment: Piper is the lightweight fallback TTS. Voice ONNX models are small.

voice.$comment: engine: auto | kokoro | piper. 'auto' prefers Kokoro, falls back to Piper.

qa.$comment: Playwright drives the web build over a local static server.

resource_notes.$comment: Informational thresholds used by 'ai-studio doctor' warnings.
resource_notes.cpu_only_warning: No GPU detected. ComfyUI will run on CPU but image generation will be significantly slower (minutes per image rather than seconds). ACE-Step is impractical on CPU.
